q: Should I reduce the contract demand on my HT electricity connection?
title: Reduce contract demand on an HT bill?
short: If your recorded maximum demand stays well below contract demand, yes. Most tariffs bill demand charges on the higher of recorded demand or a set share of contract demand, so the gap is money paid for nothing. It saves cost, not emissions; emissions follow kWh.
audience: MSMEs with HT connections paying demand or fixed charges

ol: Take 12 months of recorded maximum demand from your bills.
Find the billing floor, the share of contract demand billed when usage is low, in your state tariff order.
If peak demand plus a safety margin sits under that floor, apply to the discom to reduce.

p: Exceeding contract demand often attracts penalty rates. Leave headroom for seasonal peaks and new machines.
